title: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26745v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering visual information that is no longer observable, such as the original location of an object. Existing approaches typically rely on full observation histories, which become redundant over long horizons, or text summaries, which may omit precise visual details. We study visual moment memory, the ability to retain such details from key moments for subsequent manipulation. To support this study, we introduce VMBench, a suite of long-horizon manipulation tasks requiring memory of spatial locations, visual appearances, and their associations. We further propose MomentMem, a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM-based memorizer selects keyframes and an executor predicts actions conditioned on the selected memories. This separation enables us to evaluate memory selection alongside closed-loop task success and to study memorizer generalization independently of the executor. On VMBench, MomentMe

translated_title: MomentMem：为机器人操作记忆关键时刻
translated_abstract: 机器人操作通常需要记住不再可观察到的视觉信息，例如物体的初始位置。现有方法通常依赖于完整的观察历史，但这类历史在长时程任务中会变得冗余；或者依赖文本摘要，但文本可能遗漏精确的视觉细节。我们研究了视觉时刻记忆，即从关键时刻保留此类细节以供后续操作使用的能力。为支持这项研究，我们引入了VMBench，这是一套需要记忆空间位置、视觉外观及其关联的长时程操作任务套件。我们进一步提出了MomentMem，这是一种分层架构，其中基于VLM的记忆器负责选择关键帧，执行器则根据所选记忆来预测动作。这种分离设计使我们能够在评估闭环任务成功率的同时评估记忆选择的质量，并且可以独立于执行器来研究记忆器的泛化能力。在VMBench上，MomentMem...
tldr: 提出了MomentMem分层架构，由基于VLM的记忆器选择关键帧、执行器基于所选记忆预测动作，并引入VMBench基准来评估机器人长时程操作中的视觉时刻记忆能力。
en_tdlr: MomentMem is a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM-based memorizer selects keyframes and an executor predicts actions conditioned on the selected memories, evaluated on VMBench, a suite of long-horizon manipulation tasks requiring visual moment memory.
